changelog:
Initial release of brainblast-fleet: an autonomous agent for sourcing real, proven security footguns in popular SDKs.

- Periodically scans public code via Sourcegraph to discover new, proven security traps (VTIs) and submits them to the open Brainblast corpus.
- Fully autonomous operation managed via scheduled cron jobs, with disk and environment isolation.
- Requires no API keys; runs safely, never executes remote code, and only reads public repositories.
- Supports optional deeper candidate discovery with sub-agent workflows for advanced users.
- Includes configuration and environment variable support for managed engine checkout and submit-cap adjustment.
- Contributes direct, reproducible findings to the shared Brainblast security training registry.
summary: Autonomous, scheduled agent that finds real, proven security footguns in popular SDKs and submits them to the open Brainblast corpus.
